You left me a voicemail months back pretending you had arranged all my new medication it was the hospital that instructed you to do so and it was months later that you contacted me as if I wasn't aware.

This is a major issue for people is getting passed the " doctors " on reception!

GP - Has a duty to ensure patients care especially when on lots of medication that could not be working that is used to prevent me having another stroke!!!!!
